int _scale(int value) => value > 2 ? value * 10 : value + 1;

/// Computed when it is first read, and kept.
final table = [for (var index = 0; index < 5; index++) _scale(index)];

int lookup(int index) => index < 0 || index >= table.length ? -1 : table[index];

class Rates {
  /// Computed once as well, for the class.
  static final byName = {'low': 5 + 1, 'high': 5 * 4};

  static int of(String name) => byName[name] ?? 0;
}

/// The cases a test file declares its tests from.
List<int> cases() => [for (var index = 0; index < 3; index++) index * 2];

int half(int value) => value ~/ 2;
